content: Given that this paper is concerned with text documents (e.g. medical records), the involved techniques are related to Natural Language Processing (NLP). When using NLP approaches, it is common to pose the problem of document anonymisation as a sequence labelling problem, i.e. classifying each token within a sequence as being sensitive information or not. Further, depending on the objective of the anonymisation task, it is also important to determine the type of sensitive information (names of individuals, addresses, age, sex, etc.).
